stages.title: 資料契約、介面與不變量
stages.description: 區分寫入確認、可被搜尋與持久化，建立可見性時間線。 教學 refresh 週期 1 s；一筆在 t=2.2 s 寫入，下一次 refresh 在3.0 s。 將鍵、型別、時間或版本欄分列，指出每筆資料的唯一身份；對NULL、重複或無限邊界做明確約定。
stages.descriptionEn: Distinguish write acknowledgement,search visibility and durability in a timeline. Teaching refresh period is 1 s; a write occurs at 2.2 s and the next refresh at 3.0 s. Tabulate keys,types,time/version fields and stable identities; explicitly handle NULLs,duplicates and unbounded endpoints.
